shared_elements: dense field of inscribed signs covering a rectangular panel
text organized in horizontal rows / columns of glyph blocks
flat rectangular slab surface bearing writing
faint traces of figural relief at the margins (B)
justification: Both surfaces depict a rectangular panel densely filled with rows of inscribed signs arranged in an ordered grid-like text block, which is a real but generic correspondence shared by many writing traditions. The individual signs differ entirely in form / the left panel shows bold, deeply carved rounded cartouche-like glyphs with faces and curvilinear infill, whereas the right shows fine, shallow, small linear signs in narrow horizontal registers with figural elements at the sides.
